name: Graphify
description: A local graph of a workspace's code, built with Graphify. Code stays on this machine.

capabilities.label: Local code graph
capabilities.description: Build and query a local graph of this workspace's code (Graphify, tree-sitter, no network). The graph is stored with the extension, not in the repository.

tools.description: Say whether a graph of the working folder exists, and the symbol and connection counts. Call this after graph.build; the build keeps running and this returns at once.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace. Empty means the whole working folder.

tools.description: Start a local code graph of the working folder and return immediately. Code is parsed on this machine; nothing is sent to a model. Call graph.status to see when it is ready. Refuses when the graphify command is missing.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace. Empty means the whole working folder.

force.description: Rebuild even when the graph is already current.

tools.description: Answer a question by walking the local graph. Exit-style results: an answer, a list of candidate names when one name matches several symbols, or a clear miss. Requires a finished build.

question.description: What to look up in the graph.

budget.description: Token cap for the answer. Default 2000.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace, when the graph was built for a subfolder.

tools.description: List what connects to one symbol in the local graph. When the name matches several symbols, the answer lists them; call again with the exact one.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace, when the graph was built for a subfolder.

tools.description: Show a path through the local graph from one symbol to another.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace, when the graph was built for a subfolder.

tools.description: List the most connected symbols in the local graph.

subdir.description: Folder inside the workspace, when the graph was built for a subfolder.
